Aluminium is widely used in large supply cables and distribution networks, with proper terminations.
Copper inside homes; aluminium on poles and pylons.

quiz.q: ¿Qué color de cable es la tierra de protección en Europa?
quiz.explain: Marrón fase, azul neutro, verde-amarillo tierra.

quiz.q: Un circuito de enchufes de 2,5 mm² hace saltar una y otra vez su automático de 16 A. ¿Qué es lo correcto?
options: Buscar la sobrecarga o dividir el circuito
quiz.explain: El automático protege el cable.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué hay que desenrollar del todo un alargador de carrete para cargas grandes?
options: El cable enrollado no puede disipar el calor y puede fundirse
quiz.explain: El rollo atrapa el calor.

lessons.title: Puesta a tierra y protección
lessons.summary: Magnetotérmicos, diferenciales, tierra y protección contra sobretensiones.

cards.title: Para qué sirve la toma de tierra

steps: La carcasa vuelve a ser segura

cards.text: Las carcasas metálicas de los aparatos están conectadas a tierra. Si un cable de fase toca la carcasa, la corriente se va a tierra en lugar de pasar por ti, y salta un dispositivo de protección.

deep.x: Earthing connects exposed metal parts of appliances and installations to the ground. If a fault makes them live, current flows to earth and protection trips, rather than through a person.
Without earthing
A live metal case would wait for someone to touch it. The person would become the path to earth.
Equipotential bonding
Bonding connects metal parts together so no dangerous voltage can appear between them.
Earthing systems

items.b: earth via a local electrode, common in Portuguese homes
combined neutral and earth in supply

deep.x: Earthing gives fault current a safe path that isn't you.

cards.title: El electrodo de tierra
cards.text: En muchas casas, la conexión a tierra termina en una pica o un anillo de cobre enterrado. Su resistencia debe ser lo bastante baja para que funcionen las protecciones, y conviene medirla periódicamente.

deep.x: Many homes, including most in Portugal, connect to earth through a local electrode: a copper rod, plate or ring buried in the ground.
Resistance matters
With a 30 mA RCD, the limit is in theory up to about 1,600 Ω, but good practice aims far lower for reliability.
Soil affects it
Testing
Electricians measure earth resistance with special testers. It can change over time as soil dries or electrodes corrode.
In a TT system, the RCD does most of the protecting.

cards.title: Interruptores magnetotérmicos
cards.text: Un magnetotérmico salta de dos maneras: una lámina bimetálica para sobrecargas lentas (calor) y un electroimán para cortocircuitos (instantáneo). La letra (B, C, D) indica su sensibilidad a las corrientes de arranque.

deep.x: A miniature circuit breaker (MCB) protects a circuit against overloads and short circuits. It has two tripping mechanisms.
Ratings
Why two mechanisms

x: A small, sustained overload heats the cable slowly, so a slow trip is fine
A short circuit needs instant disconnection

deep.x: Resettable
An MCB is a fuse you can reset.

cards.title: Curvas de los magnetotérmicos
cards.text: El tipo B dispara magnéticamente a 3–5 veces su calibre, adecuado para viviendas. El tipo C, a 5–10 veces, para motores e iluminación con gran corriente de arranque. El tipo D, a 10–20 veces, para motores industriales pesados.

deep.x: The curve letter sets how much current is needed to trip the breaker's magnetic mechanism instantly. It must suit the load's inrush current.

v.unit: instant trip threshold, multiples of rating

deep.x: Choosing
Inrush current
Motors, transformers and LED drivers draw a brief surge when switched on. A type B breaker may trip unnecessarily on large inrush loads.
Trade-off
Match the curve to what the circuit powers.

cards.title: Tipos de diferencial

items: Tipo A: CA y CC pulsante

cards.text: El tipo AC solo detecta fugas de CA. El tipo A detecta también la CC pulsante de la electrónica. El tipo B detecta además la CC lisa, y a menudo se exige para cargadores de VE y algunos inversores solares (o un tipo A con un dispositivo de detección de CC).

deep.x: Residual current devices come in types that detect different kinds of leakage current. Modern electronics can produce leakage that older types can't see.
Where they're needed

items.b: washing machines, heat pumps with inverters

deep.x: EV chargers
Many EV chargers include a 6 mA DC detection device, allowing a Type A RCD upstream instead of a Type B.
Sensitivity
Electronics changed leakage currents; RCD types changed to match.

cards.title: RCBO
cards.text: Un RCBO combina un magnetotérmico y un diferencial en un solo aparato, así que un fallo en un circuito solo hace saltar ese circuito en lugar de toda la casa.

deep.x: An RCBO combines an MCB and an RCD in one device, giving each circuit both overcurrent and leakage protection.

items: a fault trips only its own circuit

deep.x: Benefits

x: Fewer nuisance trips across the house
Fridge and freezer not affected by a fault elsewhere

deep.x: Cost
RCBOs cost more than separate devices, but are increasingly common in new installations.
Typical board
One circuit, one RCBO: faults stay local.

cards.title: Protección contra sobretensiones
cards.text: Los rayos y las maniobras en la red pueden causar picos de tensión de miles de voltios durante microsegundos. Un protector contra sobretensiones (SPD) en el cuadro los desvía a tierra y protege la electrónica.

deep.x: Lightning strikes and grid switching can cause voltage spikes of thousands of volts lasting microseconds. Surge protection devices (SPDs) divert them to earth.
Types
What's at risk
SPDs wear out
Each surge consumes a little of the device's capacity. Many SPDs have indicator windows that change colour when they need replacing.
A small device in the board can save thousands of euros of electronics.

cards.title: Prueba tu diferencial
cards.text: Los diferenciales tienen un botón de prueba que simula una fuga. Pulsarlo cada pocos meses comprueba que el mecanismo no se ha quedado agarrotado. Si no salta, llama a un electricista.

deep.x: RCDs have a test button that simulates a leakage current. Pressing it periodically checks the mechanism isn't stuck.
How often
Manufacturers commonly recommend testing every few months. It takes seconds.
What the button tests
Tip
Testing switches off the protected circuits, so reset clocks and check the fridge and freezer afterwards.
A stuck RCD gives no protection until you need it.

cards.title: Doble aislamiento
cards.text: Algunos aparatos no tienen cable de tierra: tienen doble aislamiento, indicado con un cuadrado dentro de otro. Dos capas de aislamiento te protegen en lugar de una conexión a tierra.

deep.x: Some appliances have no earth wire because they're double insulated (Class II). Two independent layers of insulation protect the user instead.

items.b: double insulated, two-core cable, square-in-square symbol

deep.x: Examples
The symbol
A square inside a square on the label means double insulation. It doesn't need an earth connection.
Damage
If the outer casing cracks, the double insulation is compromised. Damaged Class II appliances should be repaired or replaced.
No earth pin doesn't mean less safe, if it's double insulated.

cards.title: Fusibles
cards.text: Un fusible es un hilo fino que se funde cuando circula demasiada corriente. Solo funciona una vez y debe sustituirse por otro del mismo calibre. Las instalaciones portuguesas antiguas aún pueden tenerlos; los cuadros modernos usan automáticos.

deep.x: A fuse is a thin conductor designed to melt when current exceeds its rating, breaking the circuit. It works once and must then be replaced.
Replacing correctly

items.w: Replace with a higher rating or wire
items.r: Replace with the same rating

deep.x: Types
Old installations
Older Portuguese homes may still have fuse boards and no RCD. Upgrading to modern breakers and RCDs is one of the most valuable electrical safety improvements.
If a fuse blows repeatedly, the fault is elsewhere.

quiz.q: ¿Qué diferencial detecta fugas de CC lisa, como exigen muchos cargadores de VE?
quiz.explain: El tipo B cubre la CC lisa.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué usar diferenciales con magnetotérmico (RCBO) en cada circuito?
options: Un fallo solo hace saltar ese circuito
Sustituyen a la puesta a tierra
quiz.explain: Los fallos quedan localizados.

quiz.q: ¿Contra qué protege un protector de sobretensiones (SPD)?
options: Picos de tensión breves por rayos o maniobras
quiz.explain: Desvía las sobretensiones a tierra.

lessons.title: Corriente trifásica
lessons.summary: Por qué la industria, las grandes bombas de calor y los cargadores rápidos usan tres hilos.

cards.title: Tres ondas desfasadas
cards.text: La alimentación trifásica tiene tres conductores de fase, cada uno con una onda de CA desplazada un tercio de ciclo (120°). En cada momento al menos una fase está cerca de su pico, así que la potencia fluye de forma suave.

deep.x: Three-phase power uses three alternating voltages of the same frequency, each shifted by a third of a cycle (120°). Together they deliver power smoothly and efficiently.
Why smooth matters
Constant power means motors run smoothly with less vibration.
Balanced loads
When the three phases carry equal loads, their currents cancel in the neutral, which then carries almost nothing.
Invention
Polyphase AC systems were developed in the late 1880s by Nikola Tesla, Galileo Ferraris and Mikhail Dolivo-Dobrovolsky, who built the first three-phase transmission line in Germany in 1891.
Three overlapping waves deliver smooth, continuous power.

cards.title: 230 V y 400 V
cards.text: Entre cualquier fase y el neutro hay 230 V; entre dos fases hay 400 V. Las casas con suministro trifásico siguen usando 230 V en los enchufes normales.

deep.x: A three-phase supply provides two voltages: 230 V between any phase and neutral, and 400 V between any two phases.
Using both
Why √3?
Because the waves are 120° apart, the difference between two phases is √3 times the voltage of one phase, not double.
At home
Even in a three-phase home, normal sockets still provide 230 V. Only special outlets or appliances use 400 V.
230 V to neutral, 400 V between phases.

cards.title: Potencia trifásica
example: 16 A por fase a 400 V, cos φ = 1
cards.text: La trifásica transporta unas tres veces la potencia de una sola fase con la misma corriente por hilo.

deep.x: Three-phase systems carry about three times the power of a single phase using the same current per conductor, with only modest extra copper.

v.f: P = √3 × V line × I × cos φ

deep.x: Examples
Comparison

v.unit: max power at 32 A per conductor, kW

deep.x: Copper efficiency
Same current per wire, three times the power.

cards.title: Por qué le encanta a la industria
cards.text: Los motores trifásicos son más simples, más pequeños y arrancan solos, y el transporte necesita menos cobre para la misma potencia. Casi toda la generación, el transporte y las cargas industriales son trifásicos.

deep.x: Three-phase power is the standard for generation, transmission and industrial loads worldwide.
Motors
Three-phase currents create a rotating magnetic field naturally. Induction motors start and run without extra starting devices, and are smaller than single-phase motors of the same power.
Transmission
Why not more phases?
Six or twelve phases are possible, but three is the best compromise between smoothness and the number of conductors.
Three phases: the sweet spot of power engineering.

cards.title: Trifásica en casa
cards.text: Las viviendas más grandes en Portugal pueden tener suministro trifásico. Permite más potencia contratada, carga de VE a 11 kW o 22 kW y grandes bombas de calor, con los circuitos repartidos entre las fases.

deep.x: Many Portuguese homes have single-phase supply, but larger homes and those with heavy loads can opt for three-phase.
When it makes sense
Costs

x: Installation changes and possibly a new meter
Fixed charges depend on contracted power, not the number of phases

deep.x: Distributing circuits
Circuits are spread across the three phases so each carries a similar load.
Some EVs can only charge at 7.4 kW on single phase but 11 kW on three-phase, cutting home charging time significantly.

cards.title: Equilibrar las fases
cards.text: Las cargas deben repartirse por igual entre las tres fases. Si una fase lleva la mayor parte de la carga, puede saltar mientras las otras van poco cargadas, y el neutro lleva corriente adicional.

deep.x: Loads should be spread evenly across the three phases. Unbalance wastes capacity and puts extra current on the neutral.
Problems with unbalance

x: One phase trips while others have spare capacity
Three-phase motors run hotter and less efficiently

deep.x: Planning
Harmonics
Some electronic loads produce harmonic currents that add up in the neutral instead of cancelling, so neutrals in office buildings may carry high currents even when phases are balanced.
Share the load and every phase does its fair part.

cards.title: Secuencia de fases

items.r: intercambia dos fases

cards.text: El orden en que las fases alcanzan su pico (L1, L2, L3) fija el sentido de giro de un motor trifásico. Intercambia dos fases cualesquiera y el motor gira al revés: una comprobación clásica en la puesta en marcha.

deep.x: The order in which the three phases peak (L1, L2, L3) is called phase rotation or sequence. It determines which way a three-phase motor spins.

items.r: Swap any two phases

deep.x: Why it matters
A pump running backwards may move little water and can be damaged; a conveyor may run the wrong way.
Checking
Electricians use a phase rotation tester before connecting motors.

steps: Connect tester to L1, L2, L3

deep.x: Swap two phases, reverse the motor.

cards.title: Estrella y triángulo

items: tensión de línea en cada devanado

cards.text: Los devanados trifásicos se pueden conectar en estrella (Y), con un punto neutro común, o en triángulo (Δ). Los motores grandes suelen arrancar en estrella para limitar la corriente y luego pasan a triángulo.

deep.x: Three-phase windings can be connected in two ways, each giving a different voltage across each winding.

items: one end of each winding joined
230 V per winding on 400 V supply

deep.x: Star-delta starting

steps: Start in star: lower voltage per winding

deep.x: Why reduce starting current
Large motors draw five to seven times their rated current when starting, causing voltage dips. Star-delta starters, soft starters and drives reduce this.
Transformers too
Distribution transformers often use delta on the high-voltage side and star on the low-voltage side, providing a neutral for 230 V loads.
Star to start gently, delta to run at full power.

cards.title: Las redes son trifásicas en todo el mundo

steps: Casas repartidas en L1, L2, L3

cards.text: Desde el generador hasta el transformador de distribución de tu calle, la energía viaja en trifásica. Cada casa con suministro monofásico está conectada a una de las tres fases.

deep.x: From generator to street transformer, power travels as three-phase. Single-phase homes are connected to one of the three phases.
Spreading homes across phases
Distribution companies connect neighbouring homes to different phases to balance the load on each transformer.
Why your neighbour may have power
In a fault affecting one phase, some homes in a street lose power while neighbours on other phases don't.
Overhead lines
Your single phase is one third of a three-phase system.

cards.title: Cómo reconocerla

items: Tres lecturas de tensión en el contador
Fases en marrón, negro y gris

cards.text: Un cuadro trifásico tiene automáticos de tres o cuatro polos y, a menudo, una toma CEE roja (5 polos) para máquinas. Los contadores trifásicos muestran tres lecturas.

deep.x: You can recognise a three-phase installation by its board, meter and outlets.
CEE sockets
Cables
Three-phase supply cables have five cores: three phases (brown, black, grey), neutral (blue) and earth (green-yellow).
Meter
A three-phase smart meter displays readings per phase and total.
Five-core cables and red sockets mean three-phase.

quiz.q: La tensión entre dos fases de una red trifásica europea es de unos…
¿Cómo inviertes el giro de un motor trifásico?
quiz.explain: Cambiar el orden de las fases invierte el campo giratorio.

quiz.q: ¿Aproximadamente cuánta potencia dan 16 A por fase a 400 V?

lessons.title: Factor de potencia
lessons.summary: Potencia activa, potencia reactiva y por qué le importan a la red.

cards.title: Potencia activa y aparente
cards.text: Con algunas cargas, la corriente y la tensión no alcanzan su pico a la vez. Entonces voltios × amperios (potencia aparente, en VA) es mayor que la potencia útil que de verdad hace trabajo (potencia activa, en W).

deep.x: When voltage and current don't rise and fall together, volts times amps (apparent power) exceeds the power doing useful work (real power).

v.f: Real power (W) = V × I × cos φ

deep.x: Example

x: With power factor 0.8: real power = 1,840 W

deep.x: What's happening
Why it costs
The extra current still flows through cables and transformers, causing losses and taking capacity, even though it does no useful work.
Power factor measures how usefully current is used.

cards.title: La analogía de la cerveza
cards.text: Imagina un vaso de cerveza: el líquido es la potencia activa, que quita la sed; la espuma es la potencia reactiva, que ocupa sitio pero no hace trabajo. El vaso entero es la potencia aparente.

deep.x: A glass of beer helps visualise power factor: liquid, foam and the whole glass.
Reading the analogy

items.b: the foam: takes space, no work
the full glass: what the system must carry

deep.x: Less foam is better
A high power factor means mostly beer: the same glass delivers more useful power.
Where it falls short
Reactive power isn't truly wasted: it sustains magnetic fields that motors and transformers need. It just flows back and forth without being consumed.
Pay for the beer, but the glass must hold the foam too.

cards.title: Qué lo causa
cards.text: Los motores, los transformadores y las reactancias de los fluorescentes almacenan energía en campos magnéticos en cada ciclo y la devuelven, así que su corriente va retrasada respecto a la tensión. La electrónica barata distorsiona la onda de corriente.

deep.x: Low power factor comes from loads that store energy in magnetic or electric fields, or that draw current in pulses.
Inductive loads
Coils store energy in magnetic fields during part of each cycle and release it later, so their current lags the voltage.
Electronics
Simple power supplies charge a capacitor only near the voltage peak, drawing short spikes of current. This distortion also lowers power factor.
Capacitive loads
Long underground cables and some LED drivers draw leading current, partly offsetting inductive loads.
Coils make current lag; cheap electronics make it spiky.

cards.title: Por qué importa
cards.text: Un factor de potencia bajo significa más corriente para el mismo trabajo útil: cables más gruesos, más pérdidas, transformadores más grandes. Las compañías cobran la energía reactiva a los clientes industriales.

deep.x: A low power factor means more current for the same useful work, increasing losses and requiring bigger equipment.

v.unit: current needed for 10 kW at 400 V three-phase, A

deep.x: Consequences
Utility charges
In Portugal, larger commercial and industrial customers are charged for reactive energy when their power factor falls below set thresholds, encouraging correction.
Grid perspective
Reactive power also affects voltage levels across the grid. Operators manage it carefully, and inverters at solar farms help regulate it.
Poor power factor makes everything carry more current than necessary.

cards.title: Corrección con condensadores
cards.text: Los condensadores consumen una corriente adelantada respecto a la tensión, que compensa la corriente retrasada de un motor. Las fábricas instalan baterías de condensadores para acercar el factor de potencia a 1.

deep.x: Capacitors draw current that leads the voltage, cancelling the lagging current of motors. Factories install capacitor banks to keep the power factor close to 1.
Types of correction

items.b: switch capacitors in steps as load changes

deep.x: Typical target
Many installations aim for a power factor of 0.95 or above, avoiding penalties and freeing capacity.
Caution
Over-correction makes the power factor leading, which can cause overvoltage. Capacitors can also resonate with harmonics, so design matters.
Capacitors supply the reactive power locally so the grid doesn't have to.

cards.title: Unidades: W, VA, var

items.b: aparente, la que llevan los cables

cards.text: La potencia activa se mide en vatios (W), la reactiva en voltamperios reactivos (var) y la aparente en voltamperios (VA). Los SAI y los generadores se especifican en VA porque su cableado debe soportar toda la corriente.

deep.x: Three related units describe the components of AC power.
Why VA ratings
UPS units, generators and transformers are rated in VA or kVA because their windings and electronics must handle the total current, whatever the power factor.
Generators
Generators are usually rated in kVA at a power factor of 0.8. A 10 kVA generator delivers about 8 kW of real power.
Watts do the work; VA sizes the equipment.

cards.title: El triángulo de potencias
cards.text: La potencia activa y la reactiva forman un ángulo recto, así que la aparente es la hipotenusa: VA² = W² + var². El ángulo entre ellas es φ.

deep.x: Real power and reactive power are at right angles, like two sides of a right-angled triangle. Apparent power is the hypotenuse.
Example
Using it
Angle
The smaller the angle, the closer to 1 the power factor.

cards.title: Tu factura doméstica
cards.text: Los hogares en Portugal pagan solo la energía activa (kWh); los cargos por energía reactiva se aplican a clientes comerciales e industriales más grandes. Eso sí, tu potencia contratada está en kVA.

deep.x: Portuguese households pay only for active energy (kWh), not reactive energy. But contracted power is in kVA, which reflects current capacity.
Why kVA for contracted power
The limit protects cables and network capacity, which depend on current, not on how useful that current is. kVA captures current directly.
At home
Most household loads are resistive or have power factor correction, so kW and kVA are similar. Old motors and cheap electronics lower it slightly.
At home you pay for watts; your limit is in volt-amps.

cards.title: Factor de potencia de los aparatos
cards.text: Las cargas resistivas, como hervidores y calefactores, tienen un factor de potencia de 1. Los motores rondan 0,8–0,9 a plena carga y mucho menos cuando van poco cargados.

deep.x: Different appliances have very different power factors, depending on how they draw current.
Lightly loaded motors
A motor running at a fraction of its rated load still needs its magnetising current, so its power factor drops sharply. Oversized motors waste capacity.
Small electronics
Small LED bulbs and phone chargers often have low power factors, but their currents are tiny, so the impact is small.
Measuring
Plug-in energy monitors often display power factor, a fun way to explore appliances at home.
Resistive loads are perfect; motors and cheap electronics are not.

cards.title: PFC en los cargadores

steps: La corriente sigue a la tensión

cards.text: Las fuentes de alimentación electrónicas más grandes, incluidos los cargadores de portátil y de VE, llevan circuitos de corrección del factor de potencia que hacen que la corriente siga la onda de tensión, como exige la normativa de la UE.

deep.x: Power factor correction (PFC) circuits make electronic power supplies draw current that follows the voltage wave smoothly, instead of in spikes.
Why required
EU rules on harmonic currents (standard EN 61000-3-2) set limits for equipment above about 75 W, effectively requiring PFC in larger power supplies.
Benefits
Active vs passive
Good chargers draw current as smoothly as a heater.

quiz.q: Una carga consume 1000 VA con un factor de potencia de 0,8. Su potencia activa es…
quiz.explain: W = VA × cos φ = 800 W.

quiz.q: ¿Qué corrige un factor de potencia inductivo en una fábrica?
quiz.explain: Los condensadores compensan la corriente retrasada.

quiz.q: ¿Qué aparato tiene un factor de potencia de aproximadamente 1?
quiz.explain: Una resistencia pura mantiene la corriente en fase con la tensión.

lessons.title: Usar un polímetro
lessons.summary: Medir voltios, amperios, ohmios y continuidad con seguridad.

cards.title: Una herramienta, muchos medidores
cards.text: Un polímetro mide tensión, corriente y resistencia, y normalmente continuidad, diodos y a veces capacidad y temperatura. Un selector giratorio elige la función y el rango.

deep.x: A multimeter combines a voltmeter, ammeter and ohmmeter in one instrument, plus extra functions.
Parts
Digital vs analogue
Choosing one

x: Auto-ranging and True RMS for convenience and accuracy
CAT III 600 V or better for household use

deep.x: One instrument, many measurements: choose the function before touching anything.

cards.title: Medir tensión
cards.text: Pon el selector en V (CA ~ o CC ⎓) y coloca las puntas en los dos puntos, en paralelo. El polímetro tiene una resistencia muy alta, así que apenas altera el circuito.

deep.x: Voltage is measured across a component or between two points, with the meter in parallel. The meter's high resistance means it barely affects the circuit.

steps: Choose V AC or V DC
Black lead to COM, red to V

deep.x: AC or DC
Typical readings
Safety

x: Hold probes by the insulated grips, fingers behind the guards
Connect black first, red second; remove red first
Never measure voltage with leads in the current socket

deep.x: Voltage is measured across, in parallel.

cards.title: Medir corriente
cards.text: La corriente debe pasar por el polímetro, en serie: abre el circuito e intercala el polímetro. Pasa el cable rojo a la entrada A o mA. Olvidarte de volver a ponerlo en su sitio es la forma clásica de fundir el fusible del polímetro.

deep.x: Current must flow through the meter: you break the circuit and insert the meter in series.
Steps

steps: Move red lead to A or mA

deep.x: The classic mistake
Leaving the red lead in the A socket and then measuring voltage creates a near short circuit through the meter, blowing its fuse or worse.

items.w: Measure voltage with lead in A socket
items.r: Always return red lead to V socket

deep.x: Easier options
For mains currents, a clamp meter is safer and faster. For small electronics, the mA range is fine.
Current goes through the meter, so the circuit must be opened.

cards.title: Resistencia y continuidad
cards.text: Mide la resistencia solo en circuitos sin tensión. El modo continuidad pita cuando la resistencia es muy baja: perfecto para encontrar cables rotos o averiguar qué cable es cuál.

deep.x: Resistance and continuity measurements use the meter's own small battery, so the circuit must be unpowered.
Uses

items.b: find broken wires, check fuses, identify cables

deep.x: Example
Why unpowered
Measuring resistance on a live circuit gives wrong readings and can damage the meter.
Continuity mode is the fastest way to find a broken wire.

cards.title: Categorías CAT
cards.text: Los polímetros llevan una categoría que indica dónde es seguro usarlos. CAT II cubre los aparatos enchufados, CAT III la instalación fija y los cuadros, CAT IV el origen del suministro. En la instalación de una casa usa como mínimo CAT III 600 V.

deep.x: Measurement categories (CAT) indicate where a meter can safely be used. The closer to the supply origin, the higher the possible energy of transients.

items: CAT IV: supply origin, meters, service cable
CAT III: fixed installation, distribution boards

deep.x: Why it matters
A high-energy voltage spike on a fuse board can make a poorly rated meter fail violently. CAT ratings guarantee the meter's insulation and protection can handle it.
Recommendation
Leads count too
Test leads have their own CAT ratings. The system rating is the lowest of meter and leads.
A cheap meter on a fuse board is a hazard, not a bargain.

cards.title: Pinzas amperimétricas

items.r: pinza en un solo conductor
separa fase y neutro

cards.text: Una pinza amperimétrica mide la corriente sin abrir el circuito: la cierras alrededor de un solo conductor y lee el campo magnético. Si rodeas el cable entero, la fase y el neutro se anulan.

deep.x: A clamp meter measures current by sensing the magnetic field around a conductor, without breaking the circuit.

items.r: Clamp around one conductor only

deep.x: Why only one conductor
Live and neutral carry equal currents in opposite directions. Clamp both and their fields cancel, reading zero.
Uses
Leakage clamps
Sensitive clamp meters can measure milliamp leakage by clamping both live and neutral: any reading is current escaping to earth, useful for finding nuisance RCD trips.
AC and DC
Basic clamp meters measure only AC. DC clamps use Hall-effect sensors, useful for solar and battery systems.
Clamp one wire to measure current safely and quickly.

cards.title: Autorrango y True RMS
cards.text: Los polímetros con autorrango eligen el rango por ti. Los True RMS miden correctamente formas de onda no senoidales (de inversores, drivers LED, variadores); los más baratos pueden equivocarse bastante con ellas.

deep.x: Two features that make a multimeter more convenient and more accurate.
True RMS

items: accurate only for pure sine waves

deep.x: Why it matters today
Modern electrical systems are full of distorted waveforms from inverters, LED drivers, variable speed drives and chargers. Average-responding meters can be off by 30% or more on such signals.
When it doesn't matter
For DC measurements and resistive loads on clean mains, any decent meter is accurate.
For modern electronics and inverters, True RMS is worth paying for.

cards.title: Comprobar un enchufe
cards.text: Para comprobar que un enchufe tiene tensión, mide entre fase y neutro (unos 230 V), fase y tierra (unos 230 V) y neutro y tierra (cerca de 0 V). Los comprobadores de enchufes de verdad también comprueban la tierra y el diferencial.

deep.x: A multimeter can check that a socket is live and correctly wired, though dedicated socket testers check more.
What readings mean
Socket testers
Plug-in testers show wiring faults with lights, and some can trigger the RCD to check it trips. They're cheaper and faster for routine checks.
Safety
Use proper probes with shrouded tips, CAT-rated, and never insert probes in a damaged socket.
Three measurements tell you if a socket is healthy.

cards.title: Comprueba la ausencia de tensión antes de tocar
cards.text: Antes de trabajar en cualquier circuito: aíslalo, bloquéalo, comprueba que no tiene tensión con un comprobador fiable y vuelve a verificar el comprobador en una fuente con tensión conocida. Nunca te fíes solo de un interruptor o de una etiqueta.

deep.x: The most important electrical safety procedure: prove a circuit is dead before working on it. Never trust switches, labels or assumptions.
Why test the tester
A broken tester reads "0 V" on a live circuit. Checking it on a known live source before and after proves it was working.
Common traps
Voltage indicators
If you haven't tested it, assume it's live.

cards.title: Medir baterías y sensores
cards.text: Los polímetros son geniales para electrónica: el estado de una batería (una batería «de 12 V» debería marcar unos 12,6 V cuando está llena), las salidas de sensores y comprobar la línea de 3,3 V de una placa ESP32.

deep.x: Multimeters are invaluable for electronics and battery checks.

v.unit: 12 V lead-acid resting voltage vs charge

deep.x: Other batteries
Electronics

x: Check a 3.3 V rail on an ESP32 or Arduino board
Read sensor outputs, such as 0–10 V or 4–20 mA signals

deep.x: Load matters
A weak battery can show normal voltage with no load but collapse under load. Testing under load gives a truer picture.
Resting voltage is a quick health check; load testing tells the full story.

quiz.q: Para medir corriente, el polímetro debe estar…
options: En los extremos de la carga, en paralelo
En serie, para que la corriente pase por él
quiz.explain: La corriente se mide en serie.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué son útiles las pinzas amperimétricas?
options: Miden corriente sin abrir el circuito
quiz.explain: Detectan el campo magnético alrededor de un conductor.

quiz.q: ¿Qué debes hacer antes de trabajar en un circuito que has desconectado?
options: Comprobar que no hay tensión con un comprobador que has verificado en una fuente con tensión
quiz.explain: Comprueba la ausencia de tensión y que el comprobador funciona.

lessons.title: Cargar coches eléctricos
lessons.summary: CA, CC, kW y por qué la carga se ralentiza.

cards.title: Carga en CA

steps: Cargador de a bordo del coche

cards.text: En casa y en la mayoría de los postes de la calle, el coche recibe CA y la convierte en CC con su propio cargador de a bordo. Ese cargador limita la velocidad, normalmente a 7–11 kW.

deep.x: With AC charging, the car receives alternating current and converts it to DC with its own on-board charger. Most home and street charging is AC.

steps: Car's on-board charger converts to DC

deep.x: Limits
Charging speed is the lowest of
Typical time
For AC, the car's own charger sets the speed.

cards.title: Carga rápida en CC
cards.text: Los cargadores rápidos convierten la CA en CC en la propia estación y alimentan la batería directamente, sin pasar por el cargador del coche. Las potencias van de 50 kW a 350 kW.

deep.x: DC fast chargers convert AC to DC inside the station and feed the battery directly, bypassing the car's on-board charger.
Power levels
Cost
DC fast charging is usually more expensive per kWh than home charging, reflecting the costly equipment and grid connections.
Battery health
Frequent fast charging adds some stress, but modern battery management limits power when the battery is cold or nearly full. Real-world data show modest effects for typical use.
DC is for journeys; AC is for daily life.

cards.title: Opciones de potencia de carga
cards.text: Un enchufe normal da unos 2,3 kW (10 A a 230 V): lento, pero suficiente de noche para trayectos cortos. Un wallbox monofásico a 32 A da unos 7,4 kW.

deep.x: Charging speed depends on the power available. Even slow charging covers most daily driving overnight.
Range added per hour
Domestic sockets
A normal Schuko socket can charge slowly, but long sessions at 10 A heat sockets and plugs. A dedicated circuit or wallbox is safer for regular use.
Most people need only a modest home charger.

cards.title: ¿Cuánto tardará?
cards.text: Divide la energía que necesitas entre la potencia de carga y añade algo de margen por las pérdidas y la fase final, más lenta.

deep.x: Estimating charging time is simple arithmetic, with a margin for losses and the slower final stage.
Examples
Daily needs
Practical tip
Most EV owners don't charge from empty to full. They plug in at night and top up what they used that day.
Daily driving usually needs only an hour or two of home charging.

cards.title: La curva de carga
cards.text: La carga en CC es más rápida con estados de carga bajos y se ralentiza a medida que la batería se llena, para protegerla. Pasar del 10 % al 80 % suele tardar más o menos lo mismo que del 80 % al 100 %.

deep.x: DC charging power isn't constant. It's highest at low charge and tapers as the battery fills, to protect the cells.
Why it tapers
As the battery fills, cell voltage rises close to its limit. The BMS reduces current to avoid stressing the cells and causing lithium plating.
Road trip strategy

items.b: the last 20% takes as long as the first 70%

deep.x: Temperature
Cold batteries charge slowly. Many EVs pre-condition the battery when you navigate to a fast charger, warming it for faster charging.
On trips, charge 10–80% often rather than to 100%.

cards.title: Coches de 400 V y de 800 V
cards.text: La mayoría de los VE usan baterías de unos 400 V. Algunos coches más recientes, como el XPeng G9 y el Porsche Taycan, usan plataformas de 800 V, que permiten más potencia de carga con menos corriente y calor.

deep.x: Most EVs use battery packs of around 400 V. Some newer models use 800 V architectures for faster charging and lighter wiring.
Benefits of 800 V
Examples

items.b: Porsche Taycan, Hyundai Ioniq 5, Kia EV6, Audi e-tron GT

deep.x: Compatibility
800 V cars can use 400 V chargers through internal converters or by switching battery halves, sometimes at reduced power.
Higher voltage lets the same cable carry more power.

cards.title: Conectores en Europa
cards.text: El tipo 2 es el conector estándar de CA en Europa. El CCS2 añade debajo dos grandes pines de CC para la carga rápida. Los coches japoneses más antiguos pueden usar CHAdeMO.

deep.x: Europe has standardised EV connectors, which makes charging simpler than in some other regions.

items.b: Type 2 plus two DC pins, fast charging

deep.x: EU rules
EU law requires public AC chargers to provide Type 2 and DC fast chargers to provide CCS2, ensuring compatibility across countries.
Tesla in Europe
Tesla cars sold in Europe use CCS2, and many Tesla Superchargers in Europe are open to other brands.
Cables
In Europe, Type 2 and CCS2 cover almost every car and charger.

cards.title: Carga inteligente en casa

items: Balanceo de carga con la casa

cards.text: Los wallbox inteligentes pueden seguir las tarifas nocturnas más baratas, aprovechar el excedente solar y reducir la potencia si la casa se acerca a su límite contratado (balanceo de carga), para que no salte el interruptor general.

deep.x: Smart wallboxes adjust charging to prices, solar production and household load, saving money and avoiding tripping the main breaker.
Load balancing

steps: Wallbox reduces charging when oven is on

deep.x: Solar charging
In solar mode, the wallbox charges only with surplus solar power. Most cars need at least about 1.4 kW (6 A) to charge, so there must be enough surplus.
Requirements in Portugal

A wallbox should be installed on a dedicated circuit with appropriate RCD protection by a certified installer. Condominium rules allow residents to install chargers in their parking spaces under specific procedures.
Smart charging uses cheap, clean hours without tripping the house.

cards.title: Mobi.E en Portugal

steps: Elige tarjeta o app de una comercializadora

cards.text: La red pública de carga de Portugal la coordina Mobi.E. Puedes usar la mayoría de los cargadores públicos con una sola tarjeta o app de cualquier comercializadora (CEME), y pagas al operador, a la comercializadora y las tarifas de red.

deep.x: Portugal's public charging network is coordinated by Mobi.E, which manages the platform that connects charging operators, electricity suppliers for mobility and users.
The players
What you pay
Changing rules
EU rules (AFIR) now require new fast chargers to accept card payments directly, and Portugal has been reforming its charging model to make ad-hoc payment simpler.
Mobi.E was launched in 2010, making Portugal one of the first countries with a nationwide interoperable charging network.

cards.title: Eficiencia y pérdidas
cards.text: Durante la carga se pierde algo de energía en forma de calor, normalmente cerca de un 10 % en la carga doméstica en CA, a veces más a potencias muy bajas. El contador del wallbox marca más kWh de los que recibe la batería.

deep.x: Not all energy from the grid reaches the battery. Some is lost as heat in the charger, cables and battery.
Why low power is less efficient
The car's electronics, pumps and battery management run during charging. At low power, these fixed losses form a larger share.
What it means
Reducing losses
Pay for the kWh at the plug, not only what reaches the battery.

quiz.q: ¿Quién convierte la CA en CC durante la carga en CA en casa?
options: El cargador de a bordo del coche
quiz.explain: La carga en CA usa el propio cargador del coche.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué la carga rápida se ralentiza por encima del 80 % aproximadamente?
options: Para proteger la batería a medida que se llena
quiz.explain: El sistema de gestión de la batería reduce la corriente progresivamente.

quiz.q: Añadir 40 kWh con un cargador de 11 kW tarda unas…

lessons.title: La energía en casa
lessons.summary: Facturas, tarifas y adónde van los kWh.

cards.title: Leer la factura
cards.text: Una factura de electricidad portuguesa tiene una parte fija (potencia contratada, por día), una parte de energía (por kWh), los cargos de acceso a la red, los impuestos (IVA, la contribución audiovisual) y, a veces, descuentos.

deep.x: A Portuguese electricity bill has several components. Understanding them helps choose the right tariff and contracted power.

items: Fixed charge: contracted power per day

deep.x: Typical breakdown
Taxes

items.b: reduced rate on part of consumption for smaller contracts, 23% on the rest
audiovisual contribution, a few euros a month
small special consumption tax per kWh

deep.x: Social tariff
Low-income households can receive the "tarifa social", a significant automatic discount on electricity.
Look at both the kWh price and the fixed daily charge when comparing offers.

cards.title: Tarifas con discriminación horaria

items: noches y fines de semana más baratos

cards.text: Las tarifas simples cobran el mismo precio todo el día. Las de dos periodos (bi-horário) tienen horas valle (vazio) más baratas, sobre todo de noche y en fin de semana; las de tres periodos (tri-horário) separan además las horas punta y llano.

deep.x: Time-of-use tariffs charge different prices at different times of day. Cheaper off-peak hours reward shifting consumption.

items: cheaper off-peak (vazio), mostly at night and weekends

deep.x: Daily vs weekly cycles

items.b: off-peak hours at the same times every day

deep.x: Typical off-peak window
In the daily cycle, off-peak typically runs overnight (for example 22:00–08:00). Exact times depend on the cycle and season.
Dynamic tariffs
Some suppliers offer prices that follow the wholesale market hour by hour (indexed tariffs), which can be very cheap at midday on sunny days or at night.
The best tariff depends on when you use electricity.

cards.title: Cuándo compensa el bi-horário
cards.text: Suele compensar si puedes llevar una buena parte de tu consumo, a menudo un 40 % o más, a las horas valle: carga del VE, calentar agua, lavadora y lavavajillas con temporizador.

deep.x: Bi-horário tariffs have cheaper off-peak prices but more expensive peak prices than simple tariffs. They pay off only if you shift enough consumption.
Break-even
Calculate
Simulators
ERSE, the Portuguese energy regulator, provides an online simulator to compare tariffs and suppliers.
Shift heavy, flexible loads to night and bi-horário can save real money.

cards.title: Adónde van los kWh
cards.text: En una casa típica, la calefacción y el agua caliente son los mayores consumos, seguidos de la cocina, la refrigeración, la colada y la iluminación. Un VE puede duplicar fácilmente el consumo del hogar.

deep.x: Household electricity use depends on whether heating and hot water are electric, and on appliances and habits.
An EV changes everything

x: similar to a typical home's total consumption

deep.x: Where savings are biggest
Measure first
A plug-in energy monitor or smart meter data reveals your real big users.
Heat is usually the biggest slice of the electricity pie.

cards.title: La nevera funciona todo el año
cards.text: Un frigorífico combi se enciende y se apaga las 24 horas, todos los días. Uno moderno y eficiente consume unos 150–250 kWh al año; uno antiguo puede consumir dos o tres veces más.

deep.x: Fridges and freezers run 24 hours a day, every day. Even small differences in efficiency add up over their 10–15-year lifetime.
Lifetime cost

x: Old fridge: 550 kWh vs new: 180 kWh

deep.x: Good habits
Position
Keep fridges away from ovens, radiators and direct sun, with space for air to circulate around the coils.
An old fridge can cost more to run than to replace.

cards.title: Etiquetas energéticas
cards.text: Las etiquetas energéticas de la UE clasifican los aparatos de la A (mejor) a la G y muestran el consumo anual en kWh. La escala se reajustó en 2021, así que una «C» nueva puede ser mejor que una «A+++» antigua.

deep.x: EU energy labels show an appliance's efficiency class and annual consumption, letting you compare models at a glance.
The 2021 rescale

items: few products reach A at launch

deep.x: So a new "C" fridge can be better than an old "A+++" one.
What the label shows
Products covered

items.b: fridges, dishwashers, washing machines, TVs, lamps
ovens, water heaters, air conditioners (being updated)

deep.x: Compare kWh per year, not just the letter.

cards.title: Iluminación LED
cards.text: Las bombillas LED consumen un 80–90 % menos de electricidad que las antiguas incandescentes para la misma luz y duran mucho más. La luz emitida se mide en lúmenes, no en vatios.

deep.x: LED bulbs use around 80–90% less electricity than incandescent bulbs for the same light, and last far longer.
Lumens not watts
Light output is measured in lumens. About 800 lumens equals an old 60 W bulb; 1,500 lumens equals 100 W.
Colour temperature
Lifespan

items.l: EU phased out most halogen bulbs

deep.x: Swap the most-used bulbs first: they save the most.

cards.title: Termos eléctricos
cards.text: Un termo eléctrico (termoacumulador) suele ser una de las mayores cargas individuales. Un temporizador para las horas baratas, un termostato más bajo (unos 50–55 °C) y un buen aislamiento reducen el coste. Los termos con bomba de calor consumen alrededor de un tercio de la energía.

deep.x: Electric water heaters (termoacumuladores) are often among the largest single electricity users in Portuguese homes.

v.unit: yearly energy for a family's hot water, kWh (approx.)

deep.x: Saving tips
Hygiene
Very low storage temperatures can encourage Legionella bacteria. Many guidelines recommend storing at 60 °C, or heating to that level regularly.
Heat pump water heaters
Solar thermal
Solar water heating panels are common in Portugal and can cover a large share of hot water needs, especially from spring to autumn.
A timer and the right temperature are the cheapest upgrades.

cards.title: Monitorización
cards.text: Los contadores inteligentes y los monitores con pinza (por ejemplo, con Home Assistant) muestran el consumo en tiempo real y revelan los consumos en espera y los hábitos caros.

deep.x: Seeing consumption in real time reveals hidden loads and expensive habits. Smart meters and home monitors make it easy.
Options

items.b: daily and monthly data from smart meter

deep.x: What people discover
Base load
Check consumption at 3 am when nothing should be running. That "base load" reveals always-on devices, often 100–300 W.
You can't save what you can't see.

cards.title: Comunidades de autoconsumo

steps: Facturas más bajas para los socios

cards.text: En Portugal, vecinos, empresas y municipios pueden formar comunidades de energía renovable y compartir la producción solar a través de la red, pagando tarifas de red por la energía compartida.

deep.x: Portugal allows renewable energy communities (CER) and collective self-consumption: neighbours, businesses and municipalities share solar production through the grid.

steps: Shared among members by agreed rules

deep.x: Types

items.b: e.g. a building's residents share rooftop solar
paid on energy shared through the grid

deep.x: Benefits

items: Use roofs without owners' own consumption

deep.x: Legal basis
Decree-Law 15/2022 set the framework for self-consumption and energy communities in Portugal, building on EU rules.
Sunshine on one roof can lower bills across a neighbourhood.

quiz.q: Con una tarifa bi-horário, ¿cuándo es más barata la energía?
options: En horas valle, sobre todo de noche y en fin de semana
quiz.explain: Las horas de vazio son el periodo barato.

quiz.q: ¿Aproximadamente cuánta menos electricidad consume un LED que una bombilla incandescente para la misma luz?
quiz.explain: Unos 8 W frente a 60 W.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál suele ser una de las mayores cargas individuales de una casa?
quiz.explain: Calentar agua requiere mucha energía.

lessons.title: Calentar y cocinar con electricidad
lessons.summary: Calor por resistencia, bombas de calor, hornos y placas.

cards.title: Calefacción por resistencia
cards.text: Los calefactores, hervidores, hornos y termos convierten la electricidad en calor mediante una resistencia: 1 kWh de electricidad da 1 kWh de calor. Es un 100 % eficiente y, aun así, caro comparado con una bomba de calor.

deep.x: Resistive heaters turn electricity into heat as current flows through a resistance. Every kilowatt-hour of electricity becomes a kilowatt-hour of heat: 100% efficient, but not the cheapest way to heat.
Where it's used
100% efficient but expensive
A heater converts all its electricity to heat, but a heat pump moves extra heat from outside, delivering several times more heat for the same electricity.
When resistive makes sense

x: Small, occasional needs: a bathroom heater for a few minutes
Very well-insulated homes with tiny heating demand
Kettles and cooking, where heat is needed fast and locally

deep.x: Converting electricity to heat is easy; moving heat is smarter.

cards.title: Bombas de calor: de 3 a 4 veces mejor

viz.unit: kWh de calor por kWh de electricidad

cards.text: Una bomba de calor traslada calor del aire exterior (o del suelo) al interior de la casa. Su eficiencia estacional típica (SCOP) es de 3–4: 1 kWh de electricidad entrega 3–4 kWh de calor.

deep.x: A heat pump uses electricity to move heat from outside into the home, like a fridge working in reverse. It delivers far more heat than the electricity it uses.

v.unit: heat delivered per kWh of electricity, kWh

deep.x: How it works

steps: Refrigerant absorbs heat from outside air

deep.x: COP and SCOP
Portugal's advantage
Mild winters make heat pumps especially efficient in Portugal: the warmer the outside air, the less work the compressor must do.
A heat pump is a heat mover, not a heat maker.

cards.title: Aire-aire frente a aire-agua
cards.text: Las bombas de calor aire-aire son los conocidos aires acondicionados split que también calientan. Las aire-agua calientan agua para radiadores, suelo radiante y el agua caliente de los grifos.

deep.x: Heat pumps come in two main types, depending on how they deliver heat indoors.

items: heat water for radiators, underfloor heating, hot taps

deep.x: Choosing
Underfloor heating
Underfloor systems need water at only 30–40 °C, which lets heat pumps work at their most efficient.
Cooling bonus
Air-to-air units also cool in summer, increasingly useful during Portuguese heatwaves.
Splits for rooms; air-to-water for whole-house systems.

cards.title: Aceite frente a convector frente a radiante
cards.text: Todos los calefactores de resistencia dan el mismo calor por kWh. Se diferencian en cómo lo entregan: los radiadores de aceite son lentos y constantes, los convectores calientan el aire rápido y los paneles radiantes calientan directamente a las personas y los objetos.

deep.x: All resistive heaters turn one kilowatt-hour into one kilowatt-hour of heat. They differ in how they deliver it and how it feels.

items.b: slow to warm, retains heat, gentle

deep.x: Which to choose

items: Large room: none, consider heat pump

deep.x: Marketing claims

items.r: All resistive heaters are 100% efficient, savings come from control

deep.x: Better thermostats and timers can save energy; the heating element itself can't beat physics.
Safety

x: Keep clear of curtains and furniture
Plug directly into a wall socket
Choose models with tip-over and overheat protection

deep.x: All resistive heaters cost the same per kWh; control is what differs.

cards.title: Hervidores: calienta solo lo que necesitas
cards.text: Un hervidor de 2 kW hierve 1 litro en unos 3 minutos. Hervir un hervidor lleno para una sola taza desperdicia energía y tiempo.

deep.x: Kettles are fast and efficient at heating water, but boiling more than you need wastes energy and time.
Example
Full kettle vs one cup
Tips

items: Use the lid on pans too

deep.x: A kettle is more efficient than a gas hob for boiling water, because the element sits inside the water.

cards.title: Inducción frente a vitrocerámica frente a gas

viz.unit: % de la energía que llega a la comida (aprox.)

cards.text: La inducción calienta la sartén directamente y tiene una eficiencia de un 85–90 %. Las vitrocerámicas (radiantes) rondan el 70 %, y los quemadores de gas, el 40–55 %. La inducción además es más rápida y fácil de controlar.

deep.x: Cooking methods differ greatly in how much energy reaches the food.
Why induction wins
Induction heats the pan base directly, wasting less heat into the air. Ceramic hobs heat the glass first, then the pan; gas flames lose much heat around the pan.
Speed and control
Indoor air
Gas cooking releases nitrogen dioxide and other pollutants indoors. Good ventilation or a cooker hood vented outside reduces exposure.
Switching cost
Induction may require new pans (magnetic bases) and sometimes a higher contracted power or dedicated circuit.
Induction puts the heat where the food is.

cards.title: Hornos y freidoras de aire
cards.text: Calentar la gran cavidad de un horno consume energía antes de empezar a cocinar. Los aparatos pequeños, como las freidoras de aire y los microondas, calientan menos volumen y a menudo consumen mucha menos energía en raciones pequeñas.

deep.x: A large oven uses energy heating its whole cavity and walls before cooking starts. Smaller appliances heat less volume and are often far more efficient for small portions.

v.unit: approx. energy for a small portion, kWh

deep.x: When the oven makes sense
Oven tips

x: Avoid opening the door: each opening loses heat
Use fan ovens at lower temperatures
Switch off a few minutes early and use residual heat

deep.x: Microwaves
Microwaves heat water molecules in food directly, with little wasted heat. They're very efficient for reheating and small quantities.
Match the appliance to the portion size.

cards.title: Termostatos y temporizadores

items: Calienta solo las salas en uso

cards.text: Cada grado menos en el termostato ahorra aproximadamente un 5–10 % de la energía de calefacción. Los temporizadores y los termostatos inteligentes calientan las habitaciones solo cuando se usan.

deep.x: Controlling when and how much you heat often saves more than changing the heater itself.
Each degree counts
Smart thermostats
Comfort tips

items.b: a jumper is cheaper than a degree

deep.x: Heat the rooms you use, when you use them.

cards.title: Primero, el aislamiento
cards.text: El kWh más barato es el que no necesitas. Aislar el tejado y las paredes, mejorar las ventanas y sellar las corrientes de aire reducen la necesidad de calefacción antes de cambiar el calefactor.

deep.x: Reducing heat loss is usually the cheapest way to cut heating bills. A smaller heating demand also makes heat pumps and solar more effective.
Where heat escapes

v.unit: typical heat loss in an uninsulated house, % (approx.)

deep.x: Quick wins

items: Seal gaps around windows and doors

deep.x: Summer benefit
Good insulation also keeps homes cooler in summer, reducing the need for air conditioning during heatwaves.
The cheapest kWh is the one you never need.

cards.title: Las casas frías de Portugal
cards.text: A pesar del clima suave, muchas casas portuguesas están mal aisladas y son frías en invierno. Portugal ha tenido una de las tasas de pobreza energética más altas de la UE, por eso los programas de eficiencia subvencionan el aislamiento y las bombas de calor.

deep.x: Despite mild winters, many Portuguese homes are cold indoors. Older buildings often lack insulation and efficient heating.
Energy poverty

items.l: Portuguese people unable to keep home adequately warm in recent EU surveys

deep.x: Health effects
Cold, damp homes increase respiratory and cardiovascular illness. Portugal has historically had high excess winter mortality compared with colder northern countries.
Programmes
In Portugal, the problem isn't the climate; it's the buildings.

quiz.q: Una bomba de calor con un SCOP de 4 que consume 1000 kWh entrega unos…
quiz.explain: Calor = SCOP × electricidad.

quiz.q: ¿Qué placa transmite más energía a la sartén?
quiz.explain: La inducción calienta la sartén directamente.

quiz.q: ¿Todos los calefactores eléctricos de resistencia dan el mismo calor por kWh?
options: Sí, 1 kWh consumido da 1 kWh de calor
No, los radiadores de aceite dan el doble
No, los termoventiladores dan la mitad
quiz.explain: Se diferencian en cómo lo entregan, no en eficiencia.

lessons.title: Electricidad estática y rayos
lessons.summary: Chispas, tormentas y protección contra el rayo.

cards.title: Carga estática
cards.text: Frotar dos materiales entre sí transfiere electrones de uno a otro. Uno queda cargado negativamente y el otro positivamente. La carga se queda quieta («estática») hasta que encuentra un camino.

deep.x: Static electricity is charge that builds up on a surface and stays there. Rubbing materials together transfers electrons from one to the other.

steps: Electrons move from one to the other

deep.x: The triboelectric series
Everyday examples
Why dry weather
Humid air helps charge leak away. In dry winter air or air-conditioned buildings, charge builds up more easily.
Static is electricity standing still, waiting to jump.

cards.title: Por qué te da calambre

items.l: más o menos cuando se nota

cards.text: Caminar sobre una moqueta con tiempo seco acumula carga en tu cuerpo, a veces miles de voltios. Toca el pomo metálico de una puerta y se descarga en una chispita. Inofensiva para ti, pero letal para la electrónica.

deep.x: Walking across carpet in dry weather can charge your body to thousands of volts. Touching metal discharges it in a quick spark.

items.l: roughly where you start to feel a spark
body charge walking on carpet in very dry air

deep.x: Why it doesn't hurt you
The charge is tiny and flows for microseconds, so the energy is very small, even though the voltage is high.
Reducing shocks

items: Touch metal with a key first

deep.x: Cars
Sliding across a car seat builds charge. Touching the metal door frame as you get out discharges you gradually.
High voltage, tiny energy: that's why static stings but doesn't harm.

cards.title: ESD y electrónica

items: Toca primero metal con toma de tierra

cards.text: Las descargas electrostáticas pueden destruir chips con tensiones demasiado pequeñas para notarlas. Por eso las placas se envían en bolsas antiestáticas y los técnicos llevan pulseras antiestáticas.

deep.x: Electrostatic discharge (ESD) can damage electronic components with voltages too small for you to feel.
Sensitivity
Hidden damage
ESD can cause immediate failure or latent damage that shortens a component's life, causing mysterious failures later.
Good practice at home

x: Touch a grounded metal object before handling boards
Keep components in their bags until needed
Avoid working on carpet in dry weather

deep.x: If you can feel it, it's already strong enough to kill a chip.

cards.title: Cómo se forma un rayo

steps: Se separan cargas en la nube

cards.text: Dentro de las nubes de tormenta, los cristales de hielo y el granizo blando chocan en fuertes corrientes ascendentes y separan las cargas. La parte superior de la nube queda positiva y la inferior negativa, hasta que el aire se rompe en una chispa gigante.

deep.x: Lightning is a giant spark that releases charge built up inside storm clouds.
Steps of a strike

items.b: faint channel zigzags down from the cloud

deep.x: Types
Thunder distance

x: Count seconds between flash and thunder

deep.x: Lightning is the atmosphere's way of balancing charge.

cards.title: El rayo en cifras

items.l: rayos por segundo en el mundo

cards.text: Un rayo típico lleva unos 30 000 amperios, a cientos de millones de voltios, durante unos pocos microsegundos, y calienta el aire a unos 30 000 °C, unas cinco veces más que la superficie del Sol.

deep.x: Lightning involves extreme currents, voltages and temperatures for a fraction of a second.
Scale
Where it strikes most
Lake Maracaibo in Venezuela holds the record for the most frequent lightning, with storms on most nights of the year.
Energy
Despite its power, a single bolt's energy is brief. It's not practical to capture lightning as an energy source.
Lightning is hotter than the Sun's surface, for millionths of a second.

cards.title: Pararrayos

steps: El rayo cae en la punta

cards.text: Un pararrayos ofrece un camino fácil a tierra, así que la descarga baja con seguridad por un conductor en lugar de atravesar el edificio. Benjamin Franklin los popularizó en la década de 1750.

deep.x: A lightning rod (air terminal) provides a preferred, low-resistance path for lightning to reach the ground safely.
Benjamin Franklin
Franklin proposed that pointed metal rods could protect buildings, and they spread quickly in Europe and America.
What rods don't do

x: They don't attract lightning from far away
They give the strike a safe path

deep.x: Modern protection
A lightning rod doesn't stop lightning; it guides it safely.

cards.title: A salvo en el coche

items.w: los neumáticos de goma te protegen
items.r: la carrocería metálica lleva la corriente a tu alrededor

cards.text: La carrocería metálica de un coche actúa como una jaula de Faraday: la corriente circula por el exterior de la carcasa metálica, no a través de las personas de dentro. Lo que te protege es el metal, no los neumáticos de goma.

deep.x: A metal car is a good place to shelter from lightning, thanks to the Faraday cage effect, not the rubber tyres.

items.r: The metal body carries current around the occupants

deep.x: How it works
Current flows over the outer metal surface and jumps to the ground. The inside stays largely protected.
Exceptions
Planes too
Aircraft are struck by lightning roughly once a year on average. Their metal or conductive skins carry the current around the cabin.
Tyres are a few centimetres; lightning has crossed kilometres of air.

cards.title: Seguridad al aire libre

items: Espera 30 minutos tras el último trueno

cards.text: Si oyes truenos, estás al alcance de un rayo. Entra en un edificio o en un coche, aléjate de árboles altos aislados, cimas y agua, y espera 30 minutos después del último trueno.

deep.x: Lightning can strike several kilometres from the storm. If you hear thunder, you're close enough to be struck.
The 30-minute rule
If caught outside

x: Avoid open fields, ridges and water
Keep away from metal fences and poles

deep.x: First aid
People struck by lightning don't carry charge and can be touched safely. Call 112 and start CPR if needed.
When thunder roars, go indoors.

cards.title: Sobretensiones en casa

steps: El SPD la desvía a tierra

cards.text: Un rayo cercano puede inducir sobretensiones en las líneas eléctricas y telefónicas que dañan la electrónica. Ayudan los protectores contra sobretensiones en el cuadro y en los equipos sensibles.

deep.x: Lightning nearby can induce large voltage surges in power, telephone and antenna lines, damaging electronics even without a direct strike.
Protection layers
Vulnerable equipment
Insurance
Many home insurance policies cover electrical damage from storms, but may require evidence of surge protection.
Protect electronics at the board and the plug.

cards.title: La estática en la industria

items: Conecta a tierra las cisternas antes de descargar

cards.text: El combustible en movimiento, los polvos y las láminas de plástico pueden acumular una estática peligrosa. Las gasolineras, los silos de grano y los talleres de pintura usan puesta a tierra y conexiones equipotenciales para evitar chispas que puedan inflamar vapores o polvo.

deep.x: In industry, static electricity can ignite flammable vapours, gases and dusts. Earthing and bonding prevent dangerous sparks.
How sparks happen
Controls

items.b: connecting containers so no spark gap

deep.x: At petrol stations
Static from a person can, rarely, ignite fuel vapour. Touch the car's metal before refuelling and don't get back into the car mid-fill.
In explosive atmospheres, a static spark is a lit match.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué estás a salvo dentro de un coche durante una tormenta eléctrica?
options: Los neumáticos de goma te aíslan
La carrocería metálica conduce la corriente a tu alrededor
Los coches son demasiado bajos para recibir un rayo
quiz.explain: Actúa como una jaula de Faraday.

quiz.q: Las descargas de estática son más frecuentes cuando…
quiz.explain: El aire seco deja que se acumule la carga.

quiz.q: La corriente típica de un rayo es de unos…
quiz.explain: Decenas de miles de amperios durante microsegundos.

lessons.title: Seguridad eléctrica
lessons.summary: Normas que mantienen a salvo a las personas y las casas.

cards.title: Tres peligros
cards.text: La electricidad hace daño de tres formas: descarga eléctrica (corriente a través del cuerpo), quemaduras (por arcos o superficies calientes) e incendio (por cables o conexiones sobrecalentados).

deep.x: Electricity can harm people and property in three main ways.
Arc flash
An arc flash is an explosive release of energy when current jumps through air. It can reach thousands of degrees and cause severe burns even without contact.
Fire
Protection
Shock, burns and fire: different hazards, different protections.

cards.title: El recorrido de la corriente importa
cards.text: La corriente de mano a mano o de mano a pie atraviesa el pecho y el corazón, los recorridos más peligrosos. La piel mojada tiene mucha menos resistencia y deja pasar más corriente con la misma tensión.

deep.x: The path current takes through the body determines how dangerous it is. Paths across the chest risk the heart.
Wet skin
Water dramatically lowers skin resistance, so the same voltage drives much more current.
Time
Even moderate currents become dangerous when they last longer. Fast disconnection by RCDs is crucial.
Wet hands and a path across the chest are the deadliest combination.

cards.title: Agua y electricidad

items: Sin enchufes normales cerca de la bañera
Equipos con grado IP en zonas húmedas
Nunca uses aparatos de red en la bañera

cards.text: Los baños y las cocinas tienen normas especiales: unas zonas alrededor de bañeras y duchas limitan qué equipos pueden ir en cada sitio, y todos los circuitos deben estar protegidos por un diferencial de 30 mA.

deep.x: Bathrooms, kitchens, pools and outdoor areas need extra protection because water lowers body resistance and connects people to earth.
Bathroom zones

items.b: inside the bath or shower tray
above it, up to about 2.25 m

deep.x: IP ratings
Common mistakes
Water plus electricity needs extra layers of protection.

cards.title: Conexiones flojas
cards.text: Un borne de tornillo flojo tiene poca superficie de contacto y más resistencia, así que se calienta, se oxida y se calienta aún más. Muchos incendios eléctricos empiezan en una conexión, no en mitad de un cable.

deep.x: Loose connections are a leading cause of electrical fires. A small contact area has higher resistance, which heats up and makes things worse.
Why it's dangerous
The heat is concentrated at one point, often hidden in a socket box or switch. A breaker doesn't trip, because current is normal.
Warning signs
Prevention

x: Periodic inspection with thermal cameras in larger installations

deep.x: Fires often start where cables connect, not in the cables themselves.

cards.title: Señales de alarma
cards.text: Llama a un electricista si ves marcas de quemado, hueles a plástico quemado, oyes chisporroteos, notas enchufes o interruptores calientes, o si los automáticos saltan una y otra vez.

deep.x: Your installation often warns you before a serious problem. Acting early prevents fires and shocks.
What to do
Older installations
Inspections
Periodic inspection by a qualified electrician is recommended for older homes, before buying a house, and after renovations.
If something smells, crackles or feels warm, switch it off.

cards.title: Si alguien está recibiendo una descarga
cards.text: No lo toques mientras esté en contacto con la fuente. Corta la corriente o sepáralo con algo seco y no conductor, llama al 112 y empieza la RCP si hace falta.

deep.x: Helping a person being electrocuted can make you the next victim. Break the circuit first.

steps: Or separate with dry non-conductive object

deep.x: Separating safely
High voltage
For overhead lines or substations, stay well away (at least several metres) and call 112. Don't try to help until the operator confirms the line is dead.
After the shock
Anyone who received a significant shock should be checked by a doctor, as heart rhythm problems and internal burns can appear later.
Break the circuit before touching the victim.

cards.title: Límites del bricolaje
cards.text: Cambiar una bombilla o enchufar aparatos no tiene problema. Los circuitos nuevos, los trabajos en el cuadro y todo lo que sea instalación fija debe hacerlo un electricista cualificado, y en Portugal las instalaciones nuevas necesitan certificación.

deep.x: Simple tasks are fine for anyone; work on the fixed installation should be done by qualified electricians.
Why
Portugal
New electrical installations and major alterations must be designed and executed by qualified professionals and inspected before connection to the grid.
Insurance
Home insurers may refuse claims for fires caused by non-compliant DIY electrical work.
If it's behind a wall or in the fuse board, call a professional.

cards.title: Regletas sobrecargadas

items.r: un aparato potente por enchufe de pared

cards.text: Enchufar varios aparatos de alta potencia en una misma regleta puede sobrecargarla, y también el enchufe de la pared. Los calefactores, hervidores y planchas deben tener cada uno su propio enchufe de pared.

deep.x: Multi-way adapters spread one socket's capacity across several appliances. Plugging in several heaters, kettles or irons can overload them.

items.w: Heater, kettle and iron on one adapter
items.r: Each in its own wall socket

deep.x: The arithmetic

x: Heater 2 kW + kettle 2.2 kW + iron 1.8 kW

deep.x: Signs of overload
Better solutions

x: Use fused power strips with overload protection
Keep high-power appliances on wall sockets

deep.x: One socket, one heater.

cards.title: Líneas aéreas

items: Ni cometas ni drones cerca de líneas
Avisa de cables caídos, no te acerques

cards.text: Nunca vueles drones o cometas, ni levantes escaleras o mástiles de barco, cerca de líneas eléctricas aéreas. La alta tensión puede saltar en arco por el aire sin que haya contacto.

deep.x: Overhead power lines carry dangerous voltages, and high voltage can arc across air without direct contact.
Safe distances
Agricultural risk
Farm machinery, irrigation pipes and tipper trailers touching lines cause many accidents in rural areas.
Fallen lines
If a line falls, stay at least 10 metres away, keep others away and call 112 or the distribution company. Treat every fallen line as live.
Look up before you lift anything long.

cards.title: El mito de los 230 V
cards.text: «Solo 230 V» bastan para matar. Lo que importa es la corriente que atraviesa el cuerpo, y a 230 V un recorrido de mano a mano con la piel mojada puede dejar pasar fácilmente más de los 30–50 mA que pueden alterar el corazón.

deep.x: "It's only 230 volts" is a dangerous belief. Household voltage can easily drive a lethal current through the body.

items.m: body resistance, about 1,000 Ω when wet

deep.x: What that current does
Why it kills
50 Hz alternating current is especially likely to disrupt the heart's rhythm, causing ventricular fibrillation within a fraction of a second.
Protection
230 V doesn't need to be "high voltage" to be lethal.

quiz.q: ¿Qué debes hacer primero si alguien se ha quedado pegado a un aparato con tensión?
options: Cortar la corriente o separarlo con algo seco y no conductor
quiz.explain: Nunca lo toques mientras esté en tensión.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué son peligrosas las conexiones flojas?
options: Su mayor resistencia hace que se calienten y pueden provocar incendios
quiz.explain: El calor y la oxidación las empeoran.

quiz.q: ¿Qué trabajo debe dejarse a un electricista cualificado?
options: Añadir un circuito nuevo al cuadro
quiz.explain: Los trabajos en la instalación fija requieren un profesional.

lessons.title: Baterías domésticas y respaldo
lessons.summary: Almacenar energía solar y mantener la luz encendida.

cards.title: ¿Por qué una batería en casa?
cards.text: Una batería guarda el excedente solar del mediodía para la noche, aumentando el autoconsumo, y puede trasladar la energía barata de la noche a las horas caras. Algunos sistemas también dan respaldo durante los cortes.

deep.x: A home battery stores electricity for later. With solar panels, it saves midday surplus for the evening; with time-of-use tariffs, it shifts cheap energy to expensive hours.
Uses
Self-consumption boost
After the 2025 blackout
Interest in home batteries with backup capability rose in Portugal and Spain after the April 2025 blackout.
A battery moves energy in time.

cards.title: Dimensionar una batería
cards.text: Dimensiona la batería según tu consumo de tarde-noche y de noche, no el de todo el día. Muchas casas consumen 5–10 kWh entre la puesta y la salida del sol.

deep.x: Size a battery to cover your evening and night consumption, not your whole day. Bigger isn't always better.

v.f: Battery size ≈ evening + night use ÷ usable depth

deep.x: Example
Oversizing
Seasonal reality
In winter, solar may not fill even a small battery. In summer, a large one fills easily. Size for typical, not extreme, days.
Measure your evening use before choosing a size.

cards.title: Inversores híbridos
cards.text: Un inversor híbrido conecta paneles, batería, casa y red, y decide hacia dónde va la energía: primero a la casa, luego a la batería y después a la red.

deep.x: A hybrid inverter manages panels, battery, house and grid together, deciding where power goes moment by moment.
Priorities
AC vs DC coupling
Monitoring
Most hybrid inverters have apps showing flows in real time and history.
The hybrid inverter is the traffic controller of a solar home.

cards.title: El respaldo no es automático
cards.text: Muchas instalaciones solares conectadas a red se apagan durante un apagón por seguridad, para que los operarios no sufran daños por energía devuelta a la línea. El respaldo necesita un inversor con conmutación en isla y un circuito de respaldo.

deep.x: Many people assume solar panels keep the lights on during a blackout. Usually they don't: grid-tied systems switch off for safety.
Why they switch off
If panels kept feeding power into a dead grid, they could electrocute workers repairing lines. Anti-islanding protection is mandatory.
What backup needs
Switching time
Some systems switch in milliseconds (unnoticed by electronics); others take seconds, briefly resetting clocks and computers.
Solar panels alone don't keep the lights on in a blackout.

cards.title: Cargas esenciales
cards.text: En lugar de dar respaldo a toda la casa, muchos sistemas alimentan un cuadro de «cargas esenciales»: nevera, luces, router, control de la caldera y algunos enchufes.

deep.x: Backing up a whole house needs large batteries and inverters. Many systems instead back up a selected "essential loads" circuit.
Typical consumption
How long

x: 10 kWh battery, 400 W average essential load

deep.x: Avoid on backup
Ovens, water heaters, EV chargers and heaters drain batteries quickly and are usually excluded.
Back up what matters, not everything.

cards.title: SAI para la electrónica

steps: La batería del SAI entra en milisegundos

cards.text: Un sistema de alimentación ininterrumpida (SAI) mantiene funcionando un ordenador, un NAS o la red durante minutos en un corte y permite un apagado ordenado. Se especifica en VA y en autonomía con una carga dada.

deep.x: An uninterruptible power supply (UPS) keeps computers and network equipment running through short outages and protects against power disturbances.

steps: Clean shutdown or bridge to restoration

deep.x: Types

items.b: switches to battery when needed, cheap

deep.x: Sizing
Uses
A UPS buys time to save work and shut down safely.

cards.title: Generadores

items.r: conmutador instalado por un electricista
ponerlo fuera, lejos de las ventanas

cards.text: Los generadores portátiles de gasolina dan respaldo, pero nunca deben funcionar en interiores (monóxido de carbono). Conectar uno a la casa requiere un conmutador adecuado para que no pueda inyectar energía en la red.

deep.x: Portable generators provide backup power for long outages, but they must be used safely.

items.w: Running a generator in the garage or indoors
items.r: Always outdoors, far from windows and doors

deep.x: Carbon monoxide
Engines produce carbon monoxide, an invisible, odourless gas that can kill within minutes in enclosed spaces. Use CO alarms.
Connecting to the house
Back-feeding through a socket can electrocute line workers and damage the generator.
Sizing
Generators belong outside, connected through a proper switch.

cards.title: Del vehículo a la casa
cards.text: Algunos VE pueden alimentar una casa mediante carga bidireccional (V2H) o dar corriente a aparatos a través de un enchufe (V2L). Una batería de VE de 70 kWh podría abastecer una casa típica durante días.

deep.x: Electric car batteries are large energy stores. Bidirectional charging lets some EVs power appliances or even a whole home.

items.b: vehicle-to-load: sockets on the car power appliances
vehicle-to-home: car powers house through a bidirectional charger

deep.x: Scale
Requirements
Examples
Several models offer V2L sockets (such as some Hyundai, Kia and MG cars), while V2H requires compatible cars and chargers, still relatively rare in Europe.
Your car's battery could keep the house running for days.

cards.title: Economía

items: Gran diferencia entre punta y valle
Poco pago por la solar vertida

cards.text: Las baterías domésticas no siempre se amortizan solo con el ahorro. Salen más a cuenta con un gran consumo de tarde-noche, tarifas con discriminación horaria, precios bajos por la energía vertida o una gran necesidad de respaldo.

deep.x: Home batteries don't always pay for themselves through savings alone. The business case depends on how they're used.
A simple estimate

x: 7 kWh battery cycling 300 days a year

deep.x: With a battery costing several thousand euros, simple payback can exceed ten years.
What improves the case
Batteries often make more sense for resilience than for pure savings.

cards.title: Seguridad y ubicación
cards.text: Instala las baterías en un lugar ventilado, fresco y seco, lejos de dormitorios y salidas, con las distancias que indique el fabricante. Para casas se prefiere la química LFP porque es más estable térmicamente.

deep.x: Home batteries store a lot of energy. Proper placement and installation reduce fire risk and extend battery life.
Chemistry choice
Temperature
Certification
Choose batteries certified to recognised safety standards and installed by qualified installers, with proper protection and isolation.
A well-placed LFP battery is a safe neighbour.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué muchas instalaciones solares se apagan durante un apagón?
options: Para no inyectar energía en líneas que los operarios creen sin tensión
quiz.explain: La protección anti-isla protege a los operarios de la red.

quiz.q: ¿Cómo debes dimensionar una batería doméstica?
options: Igual que la potencia de los paneles
Según tu consumo de tarde-noche y de noche
